title: Intermediate MEC / CEC (Regular)
tagline: A commerce-focused programme preparing students for careers in law, management, commerce and civil services.
overview: This programme is designed for students pursuing Intermediate MEC/CEC who want to develop a strong foundation in commerce, economics, mathematics, and related subjects. The curriculum focuses on conceptual understanding, academic excellence, and essential skills needed for higher education. Through structured classroom learning, regular assessments, and academic guidance, students are prepared for a wide range of future pathways in Commerce, Management, Economics, Finance, Law, and other professional fields.
highlights: Integrated CLAT and law entrance coaching
Current affairs and general awareness sessions
eligibility: Pass in Class 10 (SSC / CBSE / ICSE or equivalent).
board: Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh

sections.heading: MEC / CEC Course Structure & Examination Pattern
paragraphs: The Intermediate course under BIE-AP has two public examinations — at the end of First Year and Second Year — and is structured as:
items: Part II: Second Language (Sanskrit / Telugu / Hindi)
Part III: Group subjects, each with two papers (one per year) — MEC: Mathematics (IA & IB in First Year; IIA & IIB in Second Year), Economics, Commerce; CEC: Civics, Economics, Commerce

sections.heading: Choosing between MEC and CEC
paragraphs: MEC is the recommended group for students targeting CA, CMA, CS, IPM/BBA at IIMs, B.Com. (Hons.), Economics (Hons.), actuarial science, statistics and data-driven careers. CEC suits students who prefer a non-mathematical route into commerce, law, civil services, public administration, journalism and management.

sections.heading: Specializations
paragraphs: MEC / CEC. Integrated add-ons: CA/CMA Foundation, IPMAT, CLAT.

sections.heading: Admission requirements
items: Transfer certificate, study certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar, passport-size photographs
